## Ruling recorded — question 3 (raised in the same discussion): execution seats self-route, and triage performs no after-the-fact audit of those routings

Maintainer, verbatim (live chat with this seat, reply received between 2026-09-13T07:30Z and this write), to the seat's proposal 「落点文件无争议的卡,执行席可以按车道表自己路由(留审计评论),分诊席改做事后审计」:

> ②同意,执行席自路由,分诊也无需事后审计

**What is ruled.** An execution seat may route a card by the lane table (the domain of the package the fix lands in) without waiting for the triage seat, and the triage seat does not audit those routings afterwards. This is a ruling on `SKILL.md` 〈域车道〉 「`domain:*` 只由分诊席产出;打标签不等于认领」 and 〈多仓协调〉 rule 4 「分诊座位唯一:定级/路由/type 由它一座生产」, and on `references/core-rules.md`'s mirrors of both.

**What the seat proposed in the same breath and is awaiting the maintainer's word on** (⛔ not ruled yet, written here so the charter edit is one PR): (1) self-routing into one's own lane carries self-grading (priority + type) in the same write, with an audit comment; (2) routing a bare card into ANOTHER lane by the table is allowed, the receiving seat may re-route once on the same mechanical predicate, a second bounce goes to the decision box; (3) the triage seat keeps four duties — the sweep for bare cards nobody touched, cross-repo dedupe / shadow checks, the release board, decision-box hygiene — and cards whose body says the landing site is undecided stay with triage or go to the decision box.

Questions 1 (A / B) and 2 (the three-class table) on this card remain open. State: `needs-user-decision` kept until they are answered; the charter change lands as one PR in this lane.

Freshness gate: no comment newer than the card body at this write.

## Ruling recorded — questions 1 and 2: A — a claimed card is followed through to MERGED by the claiming seat; a cross-lane surface discovered after dispatch imports the review instead of exporting the card; in-scope derived work and unclaimed blockers stay with that seat (director seat, decision batch #131 item 1, 2026-09-13)

Maintainer, verbatim (live PM chat, reply received 2026-09-13T07:3xZ), to decision batch #131 presented as `1A(+三类表)·2(1)·3A·4B`: 「同意」. Question 3 (execution seats self-route; no after-the-fact triage audit) was ruled by the maintainer directly in the skills seat's chat and is recorded at 5651955479; this comment does not restate it. The card carries the maintainer's own questions verbatim and the per-card precedent 「17718 你直接跟进到合并。如果需要契约复审你可以派 fable」; this ruling generalises that precedent.

Derived first from the long-term axis: every hand-off is a serial point on the slowest seat, and the two things lanes buy — parallel writing and a contract-review tier — are both satisfiable inside the claiming seat after delivery; single ownership to delivery is the ordinary engineering norm. Measured this week: #17718 idle 37 h as a green PR, #17849 18 h+ unrouted, #17905 9 h. ②③④ do not overturn ①.

### What is ruled
**Q1 — ownership.** The seat that claims a card owns it to MERGED. A cross-lane surface found after dispatch (`packages/spec` included) does ⛔ not move the card; the seat imports the review — an isolated contract-review-tier reviewer sub-round (the #17718 precedent), its record carrying `Implemented-by:` / `Reviewed-by:` so a self-review is machine-visible; governed paths still park at the human terminal. `pm:retriage` re-routing applies to undispatched cards only. The `domain:spec` seat keeps the sole intake of NEW `packages/spec` work. B's mechanics land too, because they are correct regardless: the #17932 patrol row (assignee lane ≠ `domain:*`) and 「分诊不重指派」 narrowed to 「分诊不指派给新人」 so a re-route clears the assignee.

**Q2 — derived work and blockers, three classes.**
| class | test | disposition |
|:--|:--|:--|
| in-scope derived work | the card's acceptance cannot pass without it | folds in as a sub-issue under the parent; the claiming seat owns the subtree automatically; priority inherits; driven to MERGED by the same seat |
| blocker (`Blocked-by:` target) | unclaimed ⇒ the blocked seat claims and does it, any size (the S-level cap of 「简单阻塞项」 is lifted; contract surfaces by the imported review); in flight elsewhere ⇒ wait, `pm:blocking` ranks it first in that lane, the waiter is written on the blocker card; p0/p1 parents propagate priority down the chain |
| incidental finding | unrelated to acceptance | ⛔ does not fold — an independent card to the pool |

Two boundaries: one card = one PR (a trunk branch per AGENTS.md is the multi-card form); the spec seat's intake of new spec work is unchanged.

### State
`needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`; `domain:skills` / `priority:p2` kept. Landing as one charter PR in this lane together with Q3 (`SKILL.md` 〈多仓协调〉/〈认领〉/〈状态模型〉/〈域车道〉, `references/core-rules.md`, `contract-review.md`, `dispatch-runbook.md`, `state-machine.md`; governed, maintainer hand-merge).

## Ruling recorded — questions 1 and 2, and the two corollaries of question 3: the seat's recommendations accepted as written

Maintainer, verbatim (live chat with this seat, between 2026-09-13T07:52Z and this write, replying to the seat's five-item explanation): 「以上接受你的建议。」

The accepted text, verbatim from that explanation:

> **A(荐)**:认领席跟到 MERGED。具体动作:标签不换、assignee 不清;认领席起一个隔离的 fable 复核子代理审契约(就是你对 17718 那句授权的通用化),复核记录写明 `Implemented-by:` 分支、`Reviewed-by:` 席位会话;受管面照旧留 draft 给你。spec 席仍是**新** spec 卡的唯一入口(分诊路由不变),只是不再收回已交付的活。

> 验收**必需**的衍生工作 → 立成父单的 sub-issue,认领席自动拥有,同席做到 MERGED,优先级继承父单。… **阻塞项**(`Blocked-by:` 指向的卡):无人认领 → 被阻塞的席位直接认领做掉;已被别席在飞 → 等,但那张卡在对方车道排到最前(`pm:blocking` 机制已有)。… **顺带发现**(与验收无关)→ 独立卡回池子,不并,防范围蔓延。边界不变:一卡一 PR;spec 新工作入口归 spec 席。

> (a) 自路由**是否含自定级**?席位把卡路由进自己车道时,同笔打 priority 与 type。… 荐:含。 (b) 能否把**裸卡路由到别的车道**?… 荐:能;接收席不同意可按车道表改一次,第二次分歧进决策箱。… 分诊席剩四件:扫无人碰的裸卡、跨仓查重、发版板、决策箱勤务。

**What is ruled.** Q1 = **A** (a claimed card stays with the claiming seat to MERGED; a cross-lane surface imports an isolated contract-review-tier review with `Implemented-by:` / `Reviewed-by:` on the record; `pm:retriage` re-routing is pre-dispatch only; the spec seat keeps the intake of NEW `packages/spec` work). Q2 = the three-class table (in-scope derived work folds in as sub-issues owned by the claiming seat with inherited priority; an UNCLAIMED blocker is claimed and done by the blocked seat — the size cap was offered as an option and not taken; an in-flight blocker is waited on with `pm:blocking` ranking it first; incidental findings stay separate cards). Q3 corollaries: (a) self-routing carries self-grading (priority + type) in the same write; (b) a seat may route a bare card to another lane by the lane table, the receiver may re-route once on the same predicate, a second bounce goes to the decision box; the triage seat keeps the bare-card sweep, cross-repo dedupe / shadow checks, the release board and decision-box hygiene.

**State**: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` in this stroke; `priority:p2` → `priority:p1` (maintainer-directed charter revision; it also releases #17742 / #17933 / #17932's hold). **Execution shape** (fold-or-serial answered on this chain head at dispatch): one charter-revision PR in this lane carrying this card with #17950 (tiering, ruled 「我点头」), #17933 (the per-lane applicability table), #17934 (③ exception, ruled 1), #17742 (the count + the disjunct decision), #17951 (director batch duty) and #17624 (ruled B) — every member ruled, one region (`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**`, `AGENTS.md` PD #14, `scripts/pm/check-governed-*.mjs`), one hand merge; the five gates and the exclusion list are written on the chain-head claim. `Blocked-by:` liveness: none on this card. Freshness gate: comments newer than the body at this write = 5651955479 (this seat's Q3 record) only.

Ruling: direct · letter ③ · maintainer 「同意」 (live chat with the skills seat, received immediately before this record, 2026-09-13T09:51Z)

**Revision to this card's Q3 and Q2, recorded by the `domain:skills` seat (session `session_01DAcomhvR9kKizeYgg89Vo8`) in the fixed header form of #17748 item 6.** The maintainer asked, in a discussion on token and API cost, whether everything should still pass through triage (「那如果还是要求经过分诊呢？你综合评判哪个划算」); the seat compared three shapes (① all through triage; ② self-routing + self-grading, this card's Q3 as accepted at 2026-09-13T07:36Z; ③ all through triage with one exception) and recommended ③; asked 「分诊最终的结论是什么？」 the seat stated it as five points; the maintainer answered 「同意」. The five points, verbatim as presented and accepted:

> 1. **一律经过分诊。** 定级、路由、查重、跨仓 shadow 检查、`duplicate_of` 关单,全部收回分诊席一个人做;今早 Q3「执行席自路由自分级、分诊不审计」**收回**。理由是省的:分诊每轮本来就拉一次列表,查重零边际;分散到各席位则每个立卡者各拉一遍,API 更贵、token 打平、质量参差。
> 2. **唯一例外:在飞卡的衍生子卡**(今早 Q2 第一类)。拥有它的席位带父卡的域和优先级直接立卡并派发,不等分诊;分诊的小时 sweep 会事后扫到它,查到重复按 `duplicate` 关。Q2 其余三类不变。
> 3. **立卡者不查重,只在卡面附 3–5 个查重词**(包名、报错串、符号名);分诊拿这些词往自己的列表上 grep,「零命中要有对照词」的纪律随之搬到分诊。
> 4. **查重缓存住在分诊席自己的容器里**:新会话开班全量拉一次,之后 `since` 增量;不建分支、不共享、不依赖备份。
> 5. **备份是另一条线**,已立卡 #17989:Actions 定时把每张 issue 和评论快照推到你的 Cloudflare R2,与分诊缓存互不依赖。

**Effect on this card's rulings of record**: Q1 = A (follow-through to MERGED; cross-lane surfaces import the review) — unchanged. Q2 three-class table — unchanged, with class 1 (in-scope derived sub-issue, owned by the claiming seat at inherited priority) now the ONLY route that bypasses triage; classes 2–4 unchanged. **Q3 (5651976160 / 5652079343: 「②同意,执行席自路由,分诊也无需事后审计」) is WITHDRAWN** together with its corollaries (self-grading; routing bare cards to other lanes by the lane table): `domain:*`, `priority:*`, `type` and dedupe are again the triage seat's sole production; execution seats never grade or route a bare card. The triage seat's standing duties gain: dedupe on the keywords the filer attaches, with the zero-hit control; a session-local cache (full pull on a fresh session, `since` increments after). The filer's duty becomes: attach 3–5 dedupe keywords, do not pull the board.

**Charter text** (governed — rides the charter-revision PR, chain head this card): SKILL.md 立单前查重 line → 「分诊查重,立卡者附查重词」; the self-routing lines drafted for Q3 are dropped; the Q2 class-1 exception stated once; `core-rules.md` mirror in the same PR; `lanes/triage.md` gains the cache line. Ruling-ref for claims: this comment.
